Hi, I'm a week into the game and I feel like I already have a pretty good lineup. Idk if I should keep pulling one of the realms (which one?) or go for wheels. Context: I just finished chapter 3 of the story and here are my characters and wheels for reference.

Btw is the game really that generous or did I get very lucky with the pulls so far?

Hey there : )

From what I see you did get quite lucky indeed ^^
Chances to grab a limited awakener in standard should be around 1/7.
That goes up if you use etheral or luminous cores because of the guarentee though.

Your chaos and ultra roster seem fine to me but I would pull a bit more in caro / æquor.
Did you go through the trials in " records " ?

Hahaha not all of them are from standard, I pulled on moonless guide asw. But I did get 2 ghelots from the 1/7. I did most of the trials for standards, but none of them particularly stand out to me. Oh btw I also have faint, didn't fit in the screenshot. Is it worth pulling on caro to try and snipe ghelot/thais, or better to get all the aequor standards first?
Did you notice there are also trials for legacy and astral awakeners ?

Hm pulling standar with hopes to land a limited is risky at best. I suggest you pull those you still lack, then go for the wheels you want, then go back to enlighten awakeners from a specific realm.
Any limited you get will be a nice bonus but there's no garentee that you will get Thaïs even after a thousand pulls
